newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa shares slip on lacklustre results.
newsitem.headline: Absa shares slip on lacklustre results.

text.p: Shares in Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd Ltd fell on Monday after the company posted slightly weaker than expected earnings, dealers said.
"Their results are a little bit weaker than what the market expected and that's why the share is now slipping," one dealer said.
Absa stock was up 10 cents before the results but shed 55 cents to reach 29.20 rand by 0950 GMT after they were announced.
The banking group's headline earnings per share totalled 222.2 cents in the year ended March 31, 1997, against 178.0 cents in 1995/96. The dividend rose to 72.0 cents from 59.0.
Analysts polled by Reuters had forcast earnings per share of 225.5 in a range of 223.0-228.8 cents and a dividend of 73.1 cents within a range of 70.8-75.5 cents.

"Maybe the guys took the share a little bit higher on the back of the results coming out and now may be they've just decided that since the results are a bit tasteless they should knock off a bit there," one dealer added.
